messages:
Oliver: Picking up from yesterdays RFC follow-up: we need a robust pattern for replayed events where provenance is missing. proposal sketch: provisional-claim + lease + recon-audit. thoughts?
Maya: love the provisional-claim idea. it avoids blocking user-facing flows while keeping finance protected. we should keep provisional claims out of the billable ledger and instead write a shadow_charge row for visibility.
Liam: technical note: provisional claims must be idempotent and have a short-lived lease so two replayers don't both auto-claim. suggest schema field claim_lease_until and claim_lease_owner. if lease expires, recon can re-evaluate.
Sam: Agree on lease. also suggest a global backstop: after X days (tenant-configurable) any unresolved provisional claim escalates to "escalate_for_manual_review" and triggers an SLA ticket. don't let manual queues pile up forever.
Tara: Observability: emit both human-readable explain and a structured score vector from heuristics service, e.g., {fingerprint_score:0.8, session_score:0.95, recent_match:1}. UI can show the vector and the derived confidence.
Nora: For accounting correctness we should support "shadow-billing" where we record an estimated cost for a provisional claim but not invoice. That allows finance to see potential exposure. metric: meter.replay.shadow_estimated_cost_total.
Oliver: Good. We should also define the two-phase flow: 1) ingest writes event with claim_state=provisional and lease. 2) heuristics service returns decision + explain + proposed_owner. 3a) if decision==auto and confidence >= tenant_threshold -> convert provisional -> committed (emit audit event + ledger write). 3b) else keep provisional and push to recon queue.
Maya: Tenant_threshold must be overrideable per-tenant and also allow a tolerance window (e.g., if confidence in [0.8, threshold) then route to fast-path review). have tenant profile fields: replay.auto_claim_threshold and replay.escalation_days.
Liam: Implementation detail: make heuristics evaluate endpoint deterministic: input is fingerprint, candidate_owners[], event_time, and it returns {decision, confidence, evidence_ids[]}. evidence_ids link to raw ingests/traces. this keeps explainability auditable.
Sam: Edge case: what if heuristics returns owner that later gets split (multi-tenant refactor)? we need compensating transactions: create a compensating audit_event that reverses the committed ledger entries and reapplies correct ones. never delete history.
Tara: UX: Console filters: status=provisional|committed|compensated, show lease owner and lease expiry, show evidence links. Add bulk actions for finance to accept/reject a batch of provisionals for a tenant.
Nora: Also consider a reconciliation pass that attempts to re-run heuristics when new provenance data is backfilled. that pass should only touch provisionals and should produce audit events for each change. metric: meter.replay.reconcile_runs, meter.replay.reconcile_changes.
ingest-bot: started replay-reconcile job job=rec-20240401-9b3c for tenant=beta-inc, scanning 12k provisionals.
Oliver: Example minimal event shape for ingestion (informal):
```
{
  "event_id": "uuid",
  "fingerprint": "sha256(...)",
  "ingest_ts": "ts",
  "claim_state": "provisional|committed|compensated",
  "claim_lease_owner": "svc-1",
  "claim_lease_until": "ts",
  "proposed_owner": "acct-123 (optional)",
  "replay_meta": "{orig_ingest_ts:, job_id:}",
  "evidence_ids": ["trace-..."],
}
```
Liam: Add original_region and original_handshake_id as optional strings. event_id must be stable across retries; use uuidv5 over fingerprint+ingest_ts.
Maya: Important: audit_event schema must include before/after states and a reason + operator. reason values: heuristic_auto, manual_accept, manual_reject, reconcile_adjustment, backfill_override. store these in immutable audit log.
Sam: Metrics to instrument immediately: meter.replay.provisionals_created, meter.replay.auto_commits, meter.replay.manual_interventions, meter.replay.compensations, meter.replay.lease_conflicts.
Tara: For the console mock I'll include a "playback" view that shows the event timeline (original message, replay job, heuristic evaluation, lease assign, commit/compensate). helps audits.
Oliver: Ops question: how do we prevent replay storms from creating many provisionals? propose rate-limit per-tenant + a cap on open provisionals that flips incoming replays to deferred if threshold reached. deferred should still be recorded (shadow) but not queued for immediate recon.
Nora: Good call. Also add a quota_alert when open provisionals exceed X% of monthly billing events for tenant. finance wants early warning of exposure.
ingest-bot: replay-reconcile job=rec-20240401-9b3c progress=2400/12000.
Oliver: Action items: @Liam spec evaluate API + uuidv5 stability. @Maya PR tenant-config fields + backstop policy. @Sam audit_event contract + compensating-event pattern. @Tara console playback mock + bulk actions. @Nora work with finance on shadow-billing metric dashboard. I'll draft the RFC addendum with diagrams and the provisional/lease state machine.

Liam: prototyping evaluate service now.
Sam: will add audit schema tests.
Tara: mock incoming.
